ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT BY AND BETWEEN MAYER MALBIN REALTY I, L.L.C. AND 62-05 30TH AVE IX OWNER, L.L.C. Dated: as of March 5, 2024 NEW YORK COUNTY BL0CK 1016 LOTS 125AND 130 RECORDANDRETURNTO: HOLLAND&KNIGHTLLP 31WEST52NDSTREET NEWYORK,NEWYORK10019 ATTENTION: BARAK WROBEL,ESQ.

ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT made as of the 5th day of March, 2024, by and between Mayer Malbin Realty I, L.L.C. ("Owner"), New York 11101, and 62-05 30th Ave IX Owner, L.L.C. (*"Developer"), a domestic limited liability company, having an address at c/o Blumenfeld Development Group, Ltd. 300 Robins Lane, Syosset, New York 11791. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Queens, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 130 in Block 1016 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York, and as and by the street address 62-25 30th Avenue, Woodside, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"; the building and improvements located thereon are herein referred to as the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Queens, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 125 in Block 1016 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York, and as and by the street address 62-05 30th Avenue, Woodside, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “"Developer Land"; the building and improvements located thereon are herein referred to as the “Developer Building"; "Developer Parcel"); WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than is generated by the Owner Parcel (if it were treated as a separate zoning lot) pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization on the Developer Parcel and any AdditionalParcel(ashereinafterdefined); WHEREAS, the Developer Building contains more floor area than is generated by the Developer Parcel (if it were treated as a separate zoning lot) pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for the Merged Zoning Lot (as hereinafter defined) so as to allocate the Excess Development Rights to the DeveloperParcel in connection with the construction and maintenance of the Developer Building, and Owner is willing to make such Excess Development Rights available to Developer in perpetuity;
